description: Get veteran demographics for a US congressional district (118th Congress) via live Census ACS data: total population, population 18+, total veterans, veteran share, poverty count + percentage, unemployment, median household income, median gross rent. Use for congressional staff fact-sheets ("Your district has X veterans"), foundation grant proposals citing per-district veteran density, local journalism, and advocacy targeting. Without a CD param, returns ALL districts in the state ranked by veteran count.

cd.description: Optional — 1- or 2-digit congressional district number (e.g. "12" for TX-12). Omit for all districts in the state.

name: get_congressional_district_veterans
title: Veterans by congressional district
